title: Add Two Numbers
summary: Add two nonnegative integers stored in linked lists.

contractDetails.constraints: Each list has 1–100 nodes and digits in [0, 9]. A number has no leading zero in ordinary decimal notation except the number zero itself.

statement: Add two nonnegative integers stored in linked lists. Each node holds one decimal digit and the units digit comes first. Return a linked list for the sum in the same order. Examples show the list values in traversal order.

examples.explanation: The final carry adds a node.
Adding zero preserves the other number.

constraints: Each list has 1–100 nodes and digits in [0, 9]. A number has no leading zero in ordinary decimal notation except the number zero itself.
hints: Conceptual: Think of column addition starting at the units digit.
Directional: Advance along the two lists together and remember a carry.
Implementation: Treat missing digits as zero, append total mod 10 and carry floor(total/10). Continue until both lists and the carry are exhausted.
complexityAnalysis: O(max(m,n)) time and O(1) auxiliary space, excluding the result, for list lengths m and n.
